safety.zh-TW: ECHO 是 5V 訊號，禁止直接接 Pi GPIO。分壓電路不是單顆串聯電阻。
safety.en: ECHO is a 5V signal: never connect it directly to Pi GPIO. A divider is not a single series resistor.

text.zh-TW: 我已關閉 Pi 與模組的所有電源；接線過程保持斷電。
text.en: I have disconnected all Pi and module power and will keep it off while wiring.

text.zh-TW: 我已按圖準備 330Ω／470Ω 分壓電路並確認共地；這是人工確認，不是系統量測。
text.en: I have prepared the shown 330Ω/470Ω divider and common ground. This is my confirmation, not a system measurement.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 GND 接到 Pi 5 Pin 6 · GND
instruction.en: Connect GND to Pi 5 Pin 6 · GND

hint.zh-TW: 感測器與分壓電路必須共地。
hint.en: The sensor and divider must share ground.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 TRIG 接到 Pi 5 Pin 11 · GPIO17
instruction.en: Connect TRIG to Pi 5 Pin 11 · GPIO17

hint.zh-TW: TRIG 接收 Pi 的觸發訊號；不是 ECHO。
hint.en: TRIG receives the Pi trigger signal; do not confuse it with ECHO.

instruction.zh-TW: ECHO 經分壓電路接到 Pin 12 · GPIO18
instruction.en: Connect ECHO through the divider to Pin 12 · GPIO18

hint.zh-TW: GPIO18 只接兩顆電阻的交會節點。畫面不畫 ECHO 到 GPIO 的直連線。
hint.en: Connect GPIO18 only to the resistor junction. No direct ECHO-to-GPIO line is drawn.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 VCC 接到 Pi 5 Pin 2 · 5V

hint.zh-TW: 最後接 VCC，仍保持斷電；再次確認 ECHO 有分壓保護。
hint.en: Connect VCC last with power still off; recheck ECHO protection.

functionalTest.zh-TW: 尚未整合功能測試。人工檢查後上電，再以 Pi 端程式確認距離會隨物體遠近改變。
functionalTest.en: Functional testing is not integrated. After manual inspection, power on and use a Pi-side program to check that distance follows object movement.

safety.zh-TW: 僅引導已定義的訊號線。供電、BLK 背光與驅動晶片尚未核實，禁止上電；SCL／SDA 在這塊板上是 SPI。
safety.en: Signal wiring only. Supply, BLK backlight and driver IC are unverified: do not power on. SCL/SDA on this module mean SPI.

text.zh-TW: 我已關閉 Pi 與模組的所有電源；接線過程保持斷電。
text.en: I have disconnected all Pi and module power and will keep it off while wiring.

text.zh-TW: 我了解本次只有訊號線引導；VCC／BLK 保持未接，取得此模組規格前不上電。
text.en: I understand this is signal-only guidance. Leave VCC/BLK disconnected and do not power on until this module's specifications are confirmed.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 GND 接到 Pi 5 Pin 20 · GND
instruction.en: Connect GND to Pi 5 Pin 20 · GND

hint.zh-TW: 先接共地，保持所有電源關閉。
hint.en: Connect common ground first with all power off.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 SCL 接到 Pi 5 Pin 23 · GPIO11 / SCLK
instruction.en: Connect SCL to Pi 5 Pin 23 · GPIO11 / SCLK

hint.zh-TW: 此處 SCL 是 SPI 時鐘，不是 I²C Pin 5。
hint.en: Here SCL is SPI clock, not I²C Pin 5.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 SDA 接到 Pi 5 Pin 19 · GPIO10 / MOSI
instruction.en: Connect SDA to Pi 5 Pin 19 · GPIO10 / MOSI

hint.zh-TW: 此處 SDA 是 SPI 資料，不是 I²C Pin 3。
hint.en: Here SDA is SPI data, not I²C Pin 3.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 CS 接到 Pi 5 Pin 24 · GPIO8 / CE0
instruction.en: Connect CS to Pi 5 Pin 24 · GPIO8 / CE0

hint.en: Use SPI0 CE0 for chip select.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 RES 接到 Pi 5 Pin 22 · GPIO25
instruction.en: Connect RES to Pi 5 Pin 22 · GPIO25

hint.zh-TW: RES 是重設訊號；後續驅動設定必須使用相同 GPIO。
hint.en: RES is reset; the later display driver must use this GPIO.

instruction.zh-TW: 將 DC 接到 Pi 5 Pin 18 · GPIO24
instruction.en: Connect DC to Pi 5 Pin 18 · GPIO24

hint.zh-TW: DC 是資料／命令選擇。下一頁仍會列出未確認的供電項目。
hint.en: DC selects data/command. The next page will still list unresolved supply items.

reason.zh-TW: 供電電壓／電流待核實：不指定 Pi 電源腳，也不高亮接線。
reason.en: Supply voltage/current unverified: no Pi power pin or wiring target is assigned.

reason.zh-TW: 背光輸入與限流電路待核實：不可假定能直接接 GPIO。
reason.en: Backlight input/current limiting unverified: do not assume a direct GPIO connection is safe.

functionalTest.zh-TW: 尚未整合功能測試。確認模組規格與驅動後才可上電，測試色塊和文字；背光亮不代表顯示功能正常。
functionalTest.en: Functional testing is not integrated. Confirm the module and driver before powering on, then test colour bars/text; backlight alone is not a display test.

runtime.reason: TFT 供電、背光與驅動未核實；禁止上電。
